title: FloodConnect M8 policy gap record
description: advice/gap_log.py's append-only record -- one row per answer run, appended (mode 'a' only, never rewritten) to the caller's local data/policy_gap_log.jsonl (git-ignored). The answer itself carries only `policy_gap_ref` ({path, record_id}), never the full record inline -- this schema describes the LOGGED row shape, not an answer field.

record_id.description: sha256 hex digest of the record's own canonical (sorted-keys) JSON encoding, computed before record_id is added to the dict that gets hashed (record_id is excluded from its own hash input).

blockers.description: Blocker codes, e.g. a MISSING official_guidance row (advice/parity.py), or NOT_WIRED official warning feed, or missing household input (P-C UNKNOWN_ASK_INPUTS).

sensors.description: Station ids this run's decision depended on (facts + z0 + outlet).

outlet_bottleneck.description: The outlet station id, when OUTLET_CRITICAL fired, else null.

responsible_agency.description: Agency name verbatim (never invented) when the relevant official_guidance/registry row names one, else null.
